scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/client"
scripts.build: npm run prisma:generate -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/client && npm run build -w apps/server
scripts.start: npm run prisma:deploy -w apps/server && npm run start -w apps/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/server && npm run test -w apps/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/server && tsc -b apps/client
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
